I don't have access to your order history or previous calculations. Based on the notes you've provided, two items were added: a line of 400 for ladders and a line of 520 for lamps. Additionally, you mentioned taking 35 off for returned stock and 50 off for returned stock.

If these are the only transactions so far, the calculation would be:
400 + 520 - 35 - 50 = 835

However, since I don't know the starting balance or any other orders, I can't give you the final total. You may want to check your order sheet or add the remaining items to this sum.
